thread:
zoe: FYI customer hit duplicate resume charges when a websocket reconnect landed on a different shard mid-lease. billing shows two resume events for same client.

rahul: ouch. any headers/trace?

zoe: client resume headers: `X-Resume-Id: r-42`, `Cookie: _rw_route=route-5`. timeline: proxy routed to shard-7 (no active lease) -> shard-7 billed -> original shard-3 later accepted resume and billed.

ops-bot: detected spike: duplicate_resume_count=12 in us-west over last 30m.

rahul: root cause: lease ownership is only soft-state local to shard; propagation gap causes two shards to think they own session. We avoided strong coordination for perf.

zoe: customer impact small but visible; support ticket opened.

rahul: quick mitigation: increase proxy affinity TTL to 60s for streaming endpoints and set `x-sticky-route` cookie to prefer same shard. low-risk.

rahul: longer: attach `lease_id` to billing events and add a dedupe pass in billing for duplicate lease_id within 45s. That avoids immediate user-visible refunds.

billing-bot: we can implement dedupe by lease_id if it's present on events. prefer reconciliation job + dedupe TTL=45s. deferred-billing is more invasive.

ui: console change: add a lightweight "session lease timeline" in connection diagnostics (off by default) showing shards that saw resume/billing with timestamps. add a banner on tenant billing when duplicate_resume_rate>threshold with link to traces.

rahul: also propose sampling flag `stream.lease_events.sample_rate` default 0.02 to emit full lifecycle events for correlation. Gate to avoid log explosion.

zoe: plan: (1) TTL bump + sticky cookie canary (rahul) (2) billing dedupe + reconciliation prototype (billing) (3) console timeline mock (ui). I'll file RFC with example headers and minimal event schema.

ops-bot: canary created: stream-affinity-ttl-bump -> eng-platform-us-west (5% traffic).

rahul: will follow up with RFC link and small repro script.

zoe: thanks all, filing ticket and CC'ing support. end thread.
